title: “Wrong Tree” by The Lightning Struck pinpoints the feeling of unreciprocated love
htmlContent:
The Lightning Struck has a unique way of making heartbreak feel enjoyable. Their new single, "Wrong Tree," offers a catchy take on the familiar story of someone falling for the wrong person, in this case, straight men who find themselves attracted to lesbians.

"Wrong Tree" highlights the amusing (and sometimes awkward) moments of love that aren't meant to be. The band showcases their style in alternative rock, mixing playful storytelling with an energetic sound.

https://open.spotify.com/track/71p9IRS0YUGrrVMrp06wvh?si=1WalskCWTOuYLHJlruT0_A

While the song has a humorous touch, it also connects with the bittersweet feelings of rejection. Even if you haven't been in a situation where you liked someone who couldn't return the feelings, "Wrong Tree" still feels relatable. It encourages you to laugh, understand, and dance along.

"Wrong Tree" shows that The Lightning Struck can blend humor with genuine emotions. This is an alternative rock that doesn't take itself too seriously and is still sharp, heartfelt, and fun to listen to.
